evals.name: adv-rejection
evals.prompt: I'm a new salesperson and got rejected 40 times this week. Build me a 30-day plan using Og Mandino's scrolls, tell me which scroll to start with and why, and explain the law of averages idea.
assertions: Explains the 30-day reading method: silently on waking, after the midday meal, aloud before bed
Notes Scroll I (habits) is the first scroll / scrolls are read in order
Explains persistence and the law of averages (each no brings a yes closer)
Uses mood mastery or 'This too shall pass' for rejection

evals.name: adv-compare
evals.prompt: Compare Og Mandino's ten scrolls with modern habit science. Where do they agree, and where is Mandino's method unusual?
assertions: Lists or references the ten scrolls accurately
Connects Scroll I's habit-formation idea to modern habit science
Notes something unusual (e.g. reading aloud 3x/day, 30 days per scroll, prayer scroll)
Covers emotional control and/or act now
Distinguishes what the book says from the comparison
